scope: One prescribed m=4 small-time fixture; no sweep, increased precision, or all-length claim.

column_normalization.convention: Powers of epsilon multiplying actual columns.

row_convention: Ordinary-r residues of output 1 and output 2/epsilon^2, interleaved at the twelve moving poles.

nonzero_minor.order: Rows and columns in listed order.

scalar_control.projective_rule: Existing points are -X; row-form residues have homogeneous degree two. Divide by dL/dr, apply the column powers, and use output2=-output0-output1.
scalar_control.warning: Direct rational evaluation at epsilon=2; no truncated Taylor polynomial is evaluated at a unit.

nonzero_minor.order: Rows and columns in listed order.

determinant.precision_argument: At a minimum-valuation pivot v all residual entries are divisible by epsilon^v. Divide the whole residual block by epsilon^v, take its unit Schur update at precision 25-v, and restore epsilon^v. Every residual entry retains absolute precision 25.
determinant.coefficient_argument: Every selected pivot has valuation below 25, so its valuation and leading coefficient are exact. Multiply the twenty-four leading pivot terms and both permutation signs.

comparison_to_conjecture_only.scope: Comparison at this single fixture, not a uniform theorem.
